decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis app is a multi-model line close to the core offer, was presented on its own page, and fits the announced digital-practice direction, so the investment and public commitment argue for keeping it.

The education institute builds on the firm's training resources and supports customer loyalty; any weak results can be attributed to pandemic-related disruption of in-person courses, so management persists.
Remote screen-sharing support is integral to customer support and gained importance during the pandemic, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
The analytics dashboard was visibly promoted and is central to the announced direction of efficiently managed connected practices, so management continues to commit to it.
The complete practice bundle packages the core offering for new practices and is close to the established business, making it a low-cost product to sustain.

The job and practice listing portal is distant from the core and was only mentioned on the website, but it fits the firm's support for new practices and its cost is modest, so management keeps it despite the elevated risk.
